title: arabis sagittata var. borealis
intro: Arabis sagittata var. borealis, commonly known as Boreal Rockcress, is a flowering plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Arabis sagittata var. borealis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which may aid in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
